subject: Discovery recap & PoC plan \u0014 FastRetail integration
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & PoC plan  FastRetail integration

Hi Sarah  great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking through FastRetail's use case; below is a short recap and proposed PoC/onboarding plan so we can align on scope and next steps. Please flag anything I missed or that you'd like to adjust.

What we heard / pain points
- Latency and cost for store-facing product search suggestions during peak traffic (Black Friday-like spikes).
- Inconsistent relevance between in-house reranker and new LLM-based generation approach; QA teams seeing regressions in some categories.
- Tight security/compliance needs: data retention rules, audit logs, and encrypted key management.

Current stack (from call)
- Backend: Node.js microservices on AWS (us-west-2), Redis for caching, Postgres for product catalog.
- ML infra: internal reranker (PyTorch) + third-party vector store; no dedicated GPU serving today.
- Integration preference: SDK first (Python for ML team, Node.js for backend) + REST API fallback.

Success criteria for PoC
- End-to-end integration that serves 99th-percentile latencies under 200ms for 1k concurrent requests with batching/caching enabled.
- Quality: match or exceed current reranker relevance on key metrics (CTR uplift on search suggestions; demo prompt set).
- Security: keys in KMS, documented audit logs, and clear data retention settings.

Proposed PoC scope & timeline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access/NDAs + accounts provisioned. Owners: Sarah (FastRetail), Ben/Marissa (Redwood).
- Week 1: Integration  install Node.js SDK in backend, Python SDK for offline evals. Small staging dataset, API key setup, test calls.
- Week 2: Model tuning & validation  iterate prompt templates, evaluate reranker comparisons on sample queries.
- Week 3: Load testing & cost profiling  run simulated peak traffic, enable batching/cache, record latency/cost metrics.
- Week 4: Final evaluation & go/no-go  review results, success criteria, and next steps (Dedicated capacity recommendation / production rollout).

Owners & roles
- FastRetail: Sarah Johnson (Product owner), Tom Lee (SRE/Backend owner).
- Redwood: Ben Carter (AE, technical lead), Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng, SDK + integration).

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm acceptance of the scope and owners.
2) Share staging environment details (API host, service accounts) or let us know if we should provision sample keys.
3) Availability for kickoff meeting  proposed: Tue Apr 14, 10:00 AM PT.

Attachments: PoC plan + integration checklist attached (redwood-poc-plan.pdf, fastretail-integration-checklist.xlsx).

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Note: For SDKs we support Python 3.9+, Node.js 16+, and a REST API compatible with standard Bearer token auth.

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & PoC plan  FastRetail integration

Thanks Ben  this is an excellent, thorough recap. Confirming a few points and adding context.

Agree with the scope and timeline. A couple of clarifications:
- Our backend runs Node 18 in production; upgrading a small service to 16 is possible in staging but prefer Node 18 for parity. Is Node 18 supported?
- For security: we use AWS KMS with customer-managed keys, and we will need SOC2 evidence and access to audit logs for the PoC. We'll share the security questionnaire this afternoon.
- For data: we can provide a sampled query corpus and anonymized product subset for the PoC; full catalog access won't be needed initially.

Kickoff: Tue Apr 14, 10:00 AM PT works for Sarah and Tom. Please send calendar invite.

Tom: I'll loop you in on the staging credentials  expect an email with service account and VPN instructions.

Thanks  excited to get started.
Sarah
Sarah Johnson
Sr. Product Manager, Search | FastRetail
sarah.johnson@fastretail.com
